name: The Defias Brotherhood
label: Quest
description: Carrying intelligence from Master Mathias Shaw back to Westfall, this mission uncovers the mastermind behind the red-masked brigands. Shaw's report…
intro: Carrying intelligence from Master Mathias Shaw back to Westfall, this mission uncovers the mastermind behind the red-masked brigands. Shaw's report reveals that the Defias Brotherhood is led by Edwin VanCleef, the very architect who rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef. VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War. Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete. That just might explain a thing or two.
I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall. Take this to him at once!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Edwin VanCleef...I know the name well. To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. I'll need further proof before I believe this.
